problem_title: Recurring Need Lane Markings/Street Name/Road Signages — Vasanth Nagar (2019–2022)
problem_summary: 5 citizen complaints about 'Need Lane Markings/Street Name/Road Signages' were recorded in Vasanth Nagar between April 2019 and May 2022, spanning 4 calendar year(s). 100% of these complaints remain unresolved (status: Open or Re-opened).

evidence_items.source: I Change My City (ichangemycity.com) via OpenCity

evidence_items.description: KAUN 2022 data: ward recorded 166 pothole complaints.
36 road/drain work order(s) sanctioned in ward (₹48.0 crore, FY 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). Note: work order ward mapping uses datameet243 numbering (fuzzy_name join).
Ward recorded 55 road crashes in 2024, of which 7 were fatal.

hypotheses: HYPOTHESIS (unverified): Road work contracts exist in this ward, yet 100% of complaints remain unresolved. This may indicate that repairs were incomplete, inadequate, or that the work was performed in different road segments. Independent verification required.
agency_attribution_note: 5 of 5 complaints explicitly name BBMP as the responsible agency in the source data.
priority_rationale: Priority tier MEDIUM (score=0.54). Top scoring factors: recurrence_years=1.00, unresolved_rate=1.00, crash_risk=0.55.
ward_join_note: ICMC ward_name='Vasanth Nagar' matched to datameet243=128 via fuzzy_name (overlap_confidence=0.719).
recommended_next_steps: File an RTI (Right to Information) request to BBMP requesting the road repair history for Vasanth Nagar for the period 2019–2022.
Request inspection records for the 36 work order(s) sanctioned in this ward to verify whether road works covered the affected stretch.
Re-survey affected stretch using a civic volunteer or journalist to document current road condition.
Cross-reference crash location data with cluster centroid to assess whether road condition may be a contributing factor to road accidents.
